items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Esther Bidoux(?) or Lilah(?) Bolden were the singers who recorded with Piron.

ctx.x: I know it was somebody singing with that band.
Esther Bidoux(?) or Lilah(?) Bolden were the singers who recorded with Piron.
